# Generated by pyke from whiteboard.pyke - do not edit, changes will be overwritten.

add_executable(whiteboard)
target_link_libraries(whiteboard PRIVATE wb_core)
target_link_libraries(whiteboard PRIVATE SDL3)
target_link_libraries(whiteboard PRIVATE VulkanDeps)
target_link_libraries(whiteboard PRIVATE ImGui)
target_link_libraries(whiteboard PRIVATE STB)
target_link_libraries(whiteboard PRIVATE spdlog)

file(GLOB_RECURSE whiteboard_SOURCES_0 CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "src/*.cpp"
    "src/*.hpp"
)
target_sources(whiteboard PRIVATE ${whiteboard_SOURCES_0})
file(GLOB_RECURSE whiteboard_MODULES_1 CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "src/*.cppm"
)
target_sources(whiteboard PRIVATE
    FILE_SET private_modules TYPE CXX_MODULES BASE_DIRS "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}" FILES
        ${whiteboard_MODULES_1}
)
target_include_directories(whiteboard PRIVATE
    "src/"
)
add_custom_command(TARGET whiteboard POST_BUILD
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets"
        "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:whiteboard>/assets"
)
target_compile_options(whiteboard PRIVATE "$<$<BOOL:$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:MSVC>>:/W4>")
target_compile_options(whiteboard PRIVATE "$<$<BOOL:$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:GNU,Clang,AppleClang>>:-Wall;-Wextra;-Wpedantic>")
include(${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/Shaders.cmake)
wb_compile_shaders(whiteboard ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/shaders)
set_target_properties(whiteboard PROPERTIES VS_DEBUGGER_WORKING_DIRECTORY "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:whiteboard>")
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(whiteboard PRIVATE
        "/utf-8"
        "/permissive-"
        "/Zc:preprocessor"
        "/Zc:__cplusplus"
        "/MP"
    )
endif()
if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
    target_compile_options(whiteboard PRIVATE
        "-Wno-missing-designated-field-initializers"
    )
endif()
target_compile_definitions(whiteboard PRIVATE SDL_MAIN_HANDLED=1)
target_compile_definitions(whiteboard PRIVATE $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:WB_DEBUG=1>)

get_target_property(whiteboard_ALL_SOURCES whiteboard SOURCES)
if(whiteboard_ALL_SOURCES)
    foreach(_src IN LISTS whiteboard_ALL_SOURCES)
        cmake_path(ABSOLUTE_PATH _src BASE_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} NORMALIZE OUTPUT_VARIABLE _abs)
        cmake_path(IS_PREFIX CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR "${_abs}" NORMALIZE _inside)
        if(_inside)
            source_group(TREE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} FILES "${_abs}")
        else()
            source_group("External Sources" FILES "${_abs}")
        endif()
    endforeach()
endif()

if(WIN32)
    add_custom_command(TARGET whiteboard POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E $<IF:$<BOOL:$<TARGET_RUNTIME_DLLS:whiteboard>>,copy_if_different,true>
            $<TARGET_RUNTIME_DLLS:whiteboard>
            $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:whiteboard>
        COMMAND_EXPAND_LISTS
    )
endif()
